## Type of change

<!-- Mark the relevant box with an `x`. -->
- [ ] `feat:` new user-visible capability
- [ ] `fix:` bug fix
- [ ] `perf:` performance improvement
- [ ] `refactor:` no behavior change
- [ ] `docs:` documentation only
- [ ] `test:` test-only change
- [ ] `build:` / `ci:` build or CI only
- [ ] `chore:` tooling or housekeeping
- [ ] `BREAKING CHANGE:` included in the title footer (e.g. `feat!: ...`)

## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo test --workspace` passes locally
- [ ] Title follows Conventional Commits (`feat(core): ...`, `fix(daemon): ...`, ...)
- [ ] Public APIs and Varlink methods are documented
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md will be regenerated by release-plz; no manual edit needed
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, or large blobs are introduced
